sources: Codex audit 2026-05-04 — manifest has refs but no recipe library for continuity locks
HR ad continuity-score climb 3.3 → 5.7 via cooking-state anchor frames
_meta.principle: Continuity is what makes a multi-shot ad read as ONE story. Each lock below is a recipe for what to anchor across shots — applied via image_prompt clauses, character_ref scene_anchor overrides, and ingredient ref images. The pipeline must repeat these clauses verbatim across shots.

product_scale._use: Multi-shot product ads where the product must look the same SIZE across cuts. EDC knives, phones, mugs.
product_scale.clause_template: [PRODUCT] is approximately [DIMENSION] long, fits in an adult palm with [REFERENCE]
product_scale.example: the EDC knife is approximately 9cm closed, fits in an adult palm with the bolster visible past the thumb
product_scale.fail_mode_caught: product appears phone-sized in shot 2, watch-sized in shot 4 (Puck v2 bug)

character_identity._use: Same person across shots — face, hair, build, expression baseline
character_identity.example: the SAME woman every shot — dark brown hair pulled back, warm freckled complexion, expressive brown eyes, slim athletic build, gentle approachable demeanor
character_identity.fail_mode_caught: character morphs to a different ethnicity / build / hair color across cuts
character_identity.tooling: manifest.characters[].identity_constraints + Stage 0.5 character_refs (5 anchor frames per character)

wardrobe_persistence._use: Same clothes across shots set in the same scene
wardrobe_persistence.clause_template: wearing [WARDROBE], same garment as shot 1 — [SPECIFIC DETAILS]
wardrobe_persistence.example: wearing a faded olive-green cotton apron over a comfortable grey t-shirt, sleeves rolled to the elbows, same as shot 1
wardrobe_persistence.applies_to_shots: all shots within a single scene
wardrobe_persistence.fail_mode_caught: apron is olive in shot 1, brown in shot 2, missing in shot 3

hand_identity._use: Hands appearing in multiple shots — same skin tone, same nail length, same jewelry/lack-of
hand_identity.example: the same hands — warm-toned, short trimmed nails, no rings or watches, slight herb staining at the fingertips
hand_identity.fail_mode_caught: different actor's hands appear in shot 3 (common Veo bug for product-handling shots)

lighting_continuity._use: Multiple shots set in the same room/scene — light direction + color temp must match
lighting_continuity.example: soft north-window light from camera-right, neutral 5500K, slightly diffused — same as shot 1
lighting_continuity.applies_to_shots: all shots within a single scene/time-of-day
lighting_continuity.fail_mode_caught: shot 1 is golden-hour, shot 2 is blue-hour, shot 3 is overcast — viewer reads as different days

prop_persistence._use: Background props that anchor the location across shots
prop_persistence.clause_template: [PROP LIST] visible in background, same arrangement as shot N
prop_persistence.example: wooden cutting board, fresh tomatoes, stainless mixing bowl visible on the counter — same arrangement as shot 1
prop_persistence.applies_to_shots: shots in the same physical scene
prop_persistence.fail_mode_caught: kitchen has tomatoes in shot 1, oranges in shot 2, no produce in shot 3

geography_continuity._use: Spatial relationship between subject and key landmarks — viewer must understand where they are
geography_continuity.example: the woman stands at the kitchen counter, window to her right, stove visible behind her left shoulder — consistent with shot 1
geography_continuity.applies_to_shots: shots establishing or returning to a location
geography_continuity.fail_mode_caught: kitchen is on her right in shot 1, on her left in shot 3, with no transition shot to explain the flip

color_palette_lock._use: Brand-color continuity across shots — keep the accent visible
color_palette_lock.clause_template: color palette features [BRAND COLORS] — [ACCENT] appears as [PROP/DETAIL]
color_palette_lock.example: color palette features warm copper #C46A3D and beige #F7F2EA — copper appears as the kettle on the stove and the rim of the chopping board
color_palette_lock.fail_mode_caught: campaign reads as ungrounded — no recurring brand color across cuts

rules.scene_anchor_clauses_must_repeat_verbati: If a clause is meant to lock continuity, paste the EXACT same clause across all shots. Don't paraphrase — paraphrase = drift.
rules.use_veo3_ref_for_3plus_shots: For multi-shot continuity-heavy campaigns, use veo3-ref (Ingredients-to-Video) with 1-3 anchor refs over single-shot generation.
rules.character_refs_pre_render_5_anchors: Stage 0.5 generates 5 anchor angles (front, three-quarter, side-left, side-right, close-up) per character via NB2 + composeImagePrompt. These anchors get fed to veo3-ref.
